newsitem.title: CANADA: BC Tel CEO Canfield to retire.
newsitem.headline: BC Tel CEO Canfield to retire.

text.p: BC Telecom said Tuesday that chief executive Brian Canfield plans to retire although he will continue as chairman.
Canfield said he will step down as soon as a successor is appointed. The company has already begun to look for someone to fill the job, he said.

In a message to employees, Canfield said it was time to move on after 40 years with the company. He was appointed president and chief executive in 1993. He will also remain as chairman of the Stentor alliance of Canadian phone companies until a successor is named.
